Help manual

  • First run and returning to SetupComplete or skip optional guides, resume later, and relaunch one guide without resetting the Library.
  • Acquire TracksReview SoundCloud likes, match existing Tracks, queue downloads, and inspect failures.
  • Curate the LibraryImport Tracks, assign Tags and Energy, filter, build Playlists, and archive rejects.
  • Analyze Tracks and set cuesInspect background analysis, correct Beatgrid and Key, and place Main and Hot Cues.
  • Keyboard DJingChoose a Deck, load a Track, and perform with the two-hand keyboard and mouse controls.
  • ControllersCheck a controller's mapped controls and audio outputs, then tune DDJ-GRV6 jog response if needed.
  • Audio and Cue modeRoute Master and headphone audio, check PFL, and choose how paused Hot Cues behave.
  • Beat FX and filtersApply Echo, Reverb, or Flanger to a Deck or Master, and tune the shared sweep-filter sound.
  • Follow loaded TracksKeep candidate next Tracks in the browse list while Decks change.
  • Review Sessions and TakesReplay performance events, inspect detected handovers, and promote chosen evidence.
  • Mix editorBuild and review Transitions and multi-Track Routines on the slot timeline.
  • Plan and play a SetArrange Tracks, pin moves, inspect the plan and hand off Conductor playback.
  • Compare and Sync librariesRead Sync status, choose imports, and distinguish additive exports from replacements.
